name: Youth Ministry
description: Empowering the next generation with the Word of Faith. We are raising young leaders who are unafraid to manifest God's power in their generation.

name: Worship Ministry
description: Ushering the congregation into the divine presence of God through spirit-filled worship and prophetic sounds.

name: Prayer Ministry
description: The engine room of the church. Dedicated intercessors standing in the gap for the church, the nation, and individuals.

name: Outreach Ministry
description: Taking the gospel beyond the four walls of the church to communities, hospitals, and the unsaved.

name: Children Ministry
description: Building strong faith foundations early. We teach children the Word of God in a fun, safe, and engaging environment.

name: Women Ministry
description: Empowering women to fulfill their God-given potential as wives, mothers, and leaders in society through faith.
